title: Weird gets talked about
author: film-cards
hypothesis: Weird-word stories draw more comments per story than other stories.
expect: Comments per matching story against the average story of the same months, across 2006 to 2026: at least 1.1x supports (1.3x or more is strong); at or below 0.9x refutes. Between is inconclusive. Title matching only.

check.per_label: comments per story against the same-month average

group_a.label: weird and mysterious words stories ({from} to {to})

group_b.label: Average story of the same months ({from} to {to})

thresholds_note: Exploratory. Thresholds copied from the card this one replaces.
caveats: Title matching only: the word list is in scripts/film.py and will miss and mis-match some stories.
Archive scores and comment counts for recent stories are low for all stories, so only ratios against the same months are used.
Associations do not show what causes attention.
